title: Perfect Fit for My Air Cleaner
text: Perfect Fit for My Air Cleaner. This is a sturdy filter that lasts a long time.  The price was much lower than I have paid in the past.  Good value.

product_metadata.title: 83375/83376 Sears Kenmore Air Cleaner HEPA Filter
features: Genuine Kenmore 83376 HEPA replacement air purifer filter. Fits Kenmore air cleaner models: 83202, 83200, 83230, and 83355.
HEPA filter captures 99.9% of particles as small as 0.3 microns including smoke, dust, pollen, pet hair and dander, dust mite debris and mold spores.
Reduces the development of bacteria, odor, fungi and dust mites.
Replace filter once every 12 months, depending on usage and enviornment.
